description: Reproducible large outputs generated inside tools and checked through official HTTP transport

cases.expectation: 1 MiB spills and is retrieved byte-for-byte
5 MiB spills and is retrieved byte-for-byte
10 MiB spills and is retrieved byte-for-byte
Multibyte UTF-8 size and retrieval match
Escaped text has a bounded preview and exact retrieval
100,000-row list spills and is retrieved exactly
50,000-entry dictionary spills and is retrieved exactly
Approximately 6 MiB nested data is retrieved exactly
10 MiB plus one byte is rejected without a large fallback
20 MiB is rejected without a large fallback

note: Threshold and rejection cases assert unchanged output or a bounded error, respectively. Timing measurements from the previous in-process script have been replaced by committed transport tests.
